notes: Shortest series-resistance path gives a conservative copper-only drop when assigning the entire Core current to each individual path; parallel copper paths reduce actual resistance.
35um outer /17.5um inner; 2mOhm via; contact/inductor/ground-return resistance, heating, regulator ripple/transients and load regulation excluded.
2% Vref /1% feedback resistor bound is a design allowance, not a measured regulator output. Core official 0.5A requirement is not a peak-current guarantee.
